[1:40PM] #LagosBadagryExp #TrafficUpdate 

 Vehicular movement from the Agbara Customs Checkpoint through to Iyana Era. Commuters will find smooth passage from Iyana Era heading towards Iyana Isashi, with continued smooth movement from Iyana Isashi inward Afromedia. Good vehicular flow is also reported from Afromedia down to Iyana Iba, extending inward Volks.

 For those ascending the Iyana Iba flyover towards Mile 2, movement remains favorable, mirroring the good flow observed underneath the flyover inward Igando. Furthermore, traffic is moving steadily from Volks down to Barracks, and vehicular movement remains in good shape from Barracks to Abule Ado. 
Our men are present at important locations ensuring ease of movement.

#FollowLASTMA

Sinuspende ng Metropolitan Manila Development Authority #MMDA ang number coding scheme sa Biyernes, June 6, 2025 bilang paggunita sa Eid'l Adha o Feast of Sacrifice.

Idineklarang regular holiday ang June 6, base sa Proclamation No. 911 ng Palasyo. #News5

📷: MMDA
